独臂血流不止.en: Cleopatra needs Imhotep's help recovering from her wounds.
独臂血流不止.zh-CN: 克娄巴特拉需要伊姆霍特普帮助她疗伤。

description.en: Horus and Cleopatra can test the Golden Serpent techniques together.
description.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯与克娄巴特拉可以一起演练金蛇战技。

description.en: Adds 50 percentage points to Golden Serpent Sword's critical-hit chance.
description.zh-CN: 金蛇剑术的暴击概率增加50个百分点。

prompt.en: Begin the two-person trial? A loss or timeout means Game Over.
prompt.zh-CN: 开始双人试炼？失败或超时会进入游戏结束画面。

text.en: I can tend those wounds. You'll need rest, and a better way to defend yourself.
text.zh-CN: 这些伤我能处理。你需要休养，也需要学会更好地保护自己。

text.en: Will you study with me while you recover?
text.zh-CN: 养伤的时候，愿意跟我学些本领吗？

text.en: I'll study. But I don't intend to spend the rest of my life on a mountain.
text.zh-CN: 我愿意学。不过，我可没打算在山上过一辈子。

text.en: Good. I teach people to travel safely, not to fill spare rooms.
text.zh-CN: 很好。我教人平安远行，可不是为了填满空房间。

text.en: Start by sitting down. Determination isn't a bandage.
text.zh-CN: 先坐下来吧。再有决心，也不能拿它当绷带。

text.en: We'll work on control and footwork. You can make grand entrances once you can stand without swaying.
text.zh-CN: 我们先练控制和步法。等你站稳不晃了，再考虑威风地登场。

text.en: A sensible order of business. Unusual, but I'll try it.
text.zh-CN: 安排得倒是合理。有点不习惯，不过我会试试。

text.en: Rest here, Cleopatra. Horus, give her time. Come back and see us.
text.zh-CN: 克娄巴特拉，留在这里安心休养。荷鲁斯，给她些时间，再回来看我们。

text.en: I can follow Osiris's Golden Serpent Sword, but I keep losing the rhythm when I switch techniques.
text.zh-CN: 奥西里斯的金蛇剑术，我已经能跟上了。可一换招式，就总抓不住节奏。

text.en: Then let's work through it together. Imagine his attacks coming from every side.
text.zh-CN: 那就一起琢磨。想象他的攻击会从各个方向而来。

text.en: Ready, Cleopatra? Keep an eye on the serpent, not just the sword.
text.zh-CN: 准备好了，克娄巴特拉？看清灵蛇的变化，别只盯着剑。

text.en: That's it. Change the angle before they follow the blade. The sword, fist, and spell all share the same rhythm.
text.zh-CN: 原来如此。在对方跟上剑锋之前，先变换角度。剑术、拳套和法术，都能顺着同一个节奏衔接。
